title: Game Rules
subtitle: Rules published by the server for trainer levels, creature selection and battles.

a.title: Trainer levels
a.intro: Trainer level is your account progression. Every trainer starts at level {{startingLevel}} with {{startingXp}} XP, and the XP needed to advance grows by a fixed amount at each level — values come from the server.
a.tableCaption: XP needed to advance (from the server)
a.empty: No XP curve samples were provided by the server.
a.note: XP is awarded only by trusted game systems.

b.title: Creature selection
b.intro: Selecting a creature adds a species from the catalog to your collection. How many you can select depends on your trainer level and on the creature's evolution stage.
b.stage1: Stage 1 creatures: unlocked at trainer level {{unlock}}. Your allowance equals your trainer level, up to a maximum of {{cap}}.
b.stage2: Stage 2 creatures: unlocked at trainer level {{unlock}} with {{atUnlock}} allowed at unlock, plus {{increment}} more for each level after that.
b.stage2Through: These rules are defined through trainer level {{through}}.
b.stageUnlock: Stage {{stage}} creatures: unlocked at trainer level {{unlock}}.
b.stageUndefined: Stage {{stage}} creatures: selection rules are not defined yet.
b.samplesCaption: Selection allowance by trainer level (from the server)
b.samplesEmpty: No selection samples were provided by the server.
b.noStarters: The server did not list any starters.
b.note: Allowances are counted by a creature's original evolution stage at selection time, not its current stage.

c.title: Battle eligibility
c.intro: Battle modes open at different trainer levels.
c.pve: PvE (solo battles) opens at trainer level {{level}}.
c.pvp: PvP (battles against other trainers) opens at trainer level {{level}}.
c.unknown: The server did not publish this requirement.
c.notPlayable: Battles are not playable yet. These levels describe future eligibility.

d.title: Battle XP rewards
d.intro: Trainer XP awarded for each battle result, as published by the server.
d.notEarnable: These rewards cannot be earned yet because battles are not playable.
d.empty: The server did not publish battle rewards.

e.title: Evolution and trainer level
e.intro: Three different numbers exist in Battle Arena and they are never mixed up.
e.point1: Trainer level is your account progression. It decides how many creatures you can select and which battle modes you can enter.
e.point2: Evolution stage is a property of a catalog creature (stage 1, 2 or 3). It never changes your trainer level.
e.point3: Owned creature level belongs to one creature in your collection and progresses independently of your trainer level.
e.enabled: Evolution is enabled on the server.

f.title: Development status
f.intro: Battle Arena is an evolving technical portfolio project. Feature availability comes from the live API.
